name: Hanceville Primary School
summary: This Cullman County public school teaches the youngest students, from PreK through second grade. It's where reading, counting and making friends get started.

name: Hanceville Elementary School
summary: This Cullman County public school serves grades 3 through 5.

name: Hanceville Middle School
summary: This Cullman County public school serves grades 6 through 8 and gets students ready for high school.

name: Hanceville High School
summary: This Cullman County public school serves grades 9 through 12 and prepares students for college and careers.

name: Wallace State Community College
summary: Wallace State is one of the largest schools in the Alabama Community College System and offers more than 50 associate degree and technical programs right here in Hanceville.

name: Hanceville City Hall
summary: City Hall handles city business, including the City Clerk, permits, business licenses and facility rentals.

name: Mayor's Office
summary: The Mayor leads city government, works with the City Council and departments, and also votes as a member of the Council. Office hours are weekdays during business hours.

name: City Council
summary: Five elected council members and the Mayor set city policy, pass ordinances and approve the budget. Meetings are open to the public on the second and fourth Thursday of each month at 6:00 PM at City Hall.

name: Hanceville Municipal Court
summary: The Municipal Court handles city citations, and you can look up and pay tickets online through its payment portal.

name: Emergency: Call 911
summary: For any emergency in Hanceville, dial 911 and Cullman County E911 will send help right away.

name: Hanceville Fire and Rescue
summary: Hanceville Fire and Rescue answers emergency calls around the clock and also offers burn permits, CPR courses and smoke alarm installations. Use the number listed here for non emergency questions.

name: Cullman County Sheriff's Office
summary: The Sheriff's Office now provides law enforcement for Hanceville, including patrol, investigations and calls for service, after the city police department was dissolved in 2026.

name: Hanceville Water and Sewer Board
summary: Established in 1925, the board provides water and sewer service to the Hanceville area. You can pay your water bill online through the city website.

name: Public Works Department
summary: Public Works handles street repair, maintenance and brush collection. Call City Hall for help.

name: Shirley Burden Public Library
summary: Hanceville's public library has served readers since the 1930s. Stop in for books, children's programs and a friendly place to sit a while. It's open Tuesday through Saturday.
hours: Tuesday to Friday 8 AM to 5 PM (closed noon to 1 PM), Saturday 9 AM to 1 PM, closed Monday

name: Parks and Recreation
summary: Parks and Recreation runs four city parks. C. W. Day Park has ball fields, playgrounds and a community pool, and Veterans Memorial Park has a walking trail and fishing. You can book facility rentals online. Call City Hall with questions.

name: Hanceville Senior Center
summary: A Cullman County Commission on Aging senior center. Seniors 60 and older can come for a free hot lunch and company on weekdays, 8:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m.

name: Hanceville Post Office
summary: The local post office handles mail, packages and PO boxes for the 35077 ZIP code.

name: Cullman County Emergency Management Agency
summary: The EMA plans for storms and disasters and helps people get ready before bad weather hits. Call the number listed here for non emergency questions.

name: Secret Witness Tip Line
summary: Report criminal activity anonymously to the Cullman County Sheriff's Office with this tip line.

name: Cullman County Sanitation Department
summary: The county sanitation department handles garbage service questions for Cullman County.
